en-US.description: A third-party Bilibili client built with Flutter
en-US.longDescription:
A third-party Bilibili client built with Flutter.
PiliPlus is a personal project developed for educational purposes, intended only for learning and testing. Please delete it within 24 hours of downloading. All APIs used were collected from the official website. This project does not provide any cracked content.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Flutter 开发的 BiliBili 第三方客户端
zh-CN.longDescription:
基于 Flutter 构建的第三方哔哩哔哩客户端。
PiliPlus 是一个出于教育目的开发的个人项目，仅供学习与测试使用。请在下载后 24 小时内删除。所使用的所有 API 均收集自官方网站。本项目不提供任何破解内容。
